'''August 2000 Framingham tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Framingham, MA on 5 August 2000. [[Justin Desai]] won it. It is known from Justin Desai's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1105">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-08-framingham-mass-8-5-00d1105/ framingham-mass-8-5-00], DeckTech (Justin "H2O" Desai, 8 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-08-framingham-mass-8-5-00d1105/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Framingham, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Desai]]
